newsitem.title: USA: US MMS sets meetings on royalties-in-kind programs.
newsitem.headline: US MMS sets meetings on royalties-in-kind programs.

text.p: The U.S. Minerals Management Service said on Wednesday it will hold a series of public meetings on ways to expand the federal royalties-in-kind programs onshore and in the Outer Continental Shelf.
Under royalties-in-kind programs, oil or gas is used instead of cash to pay royalties to the government for gas or oil extracted from federal land or the OCS.
Options being considered are taking OCS and onshore oil production in kind and taking OCS natural gas in kind, the MMS said.
The MMS will hold meetings in Houston on March 18 for OCS oil, and March 19 for OCS gas, in Casper, Wyoming, on March 25 on onshore oil, and in New Orleans April 1 on OCS oil and April 2 on OSC gas.
After these workshops, there will be a second series of sessions on the issue of onshore gas royalties-in-kind, which the MMS said presents more complex marketing and transportation challenges.
The MMS in 1995 conducted a royalty gas marketing project in the Gulf of Mexico, selling its royalty gas to competitively selected gas marketers.
The agency decided that royalties-in-kind were feasible, but revenues were less than would have been collected if paid in the usual manner.
The MMS said it was considering alternatives based on lessons learned from the pilot program.
